events.body:
## Context

`src/pages/docs-decrypt.html`, `docs-security.html` and `docs-org-onboarding.html` describe an ECDH/JWK flow with `tools/org_decrypt.py`. The real flow is a browser-side AES-256 ZIP whose password is emailed (README "Cryptography & Decryption"). Orgs following the live docs can't decrypt what they receive.

## What to do

1. Rewrite the three pages to match the README, with decrypt steps for Windows (7-Zip), macOS and Linux.
2. Don't change `tools/` or the `/admin/onboard` form.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No JWK/ECDH wording on `/docs/*`
- [ ] Decrypt steps for all three OSes
- [ ] `tests/test_routes.py` still passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-zero
cd blt-zero && npx wrangler dev   # visit /docs/decrypt
```

---
